name: SUFU negative regulator of hedgehog signaling

function.text: SUFU encodes suppressor of fused homolog. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and protein sequestering activity. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to medulloblastoma (autosomal dominant); nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Medulloblastoma; Basal cell carcinoma of skin. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
